facts.fact: Organic Law 2004-63 of 27 July 2004, arts. 50-52, bars transfer of personal data abroad where it harms public security or Tunisia's vital interests, allows it only to a country with an adequate level of protection, and requires prior authorisation of the data protection authority (INPDP) in every case, decided within one month; the document notes no replacement law had been adopted at its 2026 retrieval.

systems.owner: Instance Nationale de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (INPDP)
